title: Numbers, time and dates
sub: Es la una, son las dos
can: Say the time, arrange when to meet, understand prices and talk about days of the week.
doneText: You can now tell the time, arrange to meet on a day and at a time, and follow prices.

skills.es-son: Es la una or son las…

discover.intro: All of these sentences tell the time. Spot why some start with es and others with son.
discover.question: Why es in blue and son in orange?
options: One o'clock is singular (one hour), so es la una. Every other hour is plural, so son las…
Blue sentences are in the morning, orange ones in the afternoon.
Es is formal, son is informal.
discover.nudge: Not quite. Look at the number straight after la or las in each colour.
discover.reveal: La una is one hour, so it is singular: es. Two o'clock and later are plural: son las dos. Then add minutes with y (past) or menos (to):

hooks.title: When: a, de, el, los
rows: a las diez de la noche

learn.title: The numbers
learn.sub: Tap any number to hear it

blocks.text: 16 to 29 are one word: dieciséis, veintidós. From 31 up, use y: treinta y uno, cuarenta y cinco.

blocks.title: el lunes or los lunes
blocks.note: There is no word for "on" with days. El means one day, los means every week. Days and months are lowercase: el lunes, en enero.

blocks.text: Spain eats late: lunch around 2 to 3pm, dinner around 9 to 10pm. Timetables use the 24-hour clock (21:00), but in conversation people say a las nueve de la noche.
Uno becomes un before a noun: un café, veintiún años. And age uses tener: tengo treinta años.

exercises.why: One o'clock is singular: es la una.
Menos cuarto means quarter to: ten minus a quarter is 9:45.

items.why: Days use ser: hoy es martes.
12:45 still counts from la una, so es.

items.full: Son las ocho de la tarde.

items.why: The question is always ¿Qué hora es?

exercises.prompt: Tap the word that is wrong.
exercises.why: At a time is a: a las ocho. En is for places and months.
Two is plural, so son las. Half past is y media.
Every Monday is los lunes. No en with days.
5:40 is twenty to six: las seis menos veinte.

exercises.prompt: Let's meet on Saturday at nine.
exercises.answer: Quedamos el sábado a las nueve.
exercises.why: El sábado for one day, then a las for the time.
¿Cuánto cuesta? or ¿Cuánto vale? For the total bill: ¿Cuánto es?
From 31 up: tens, then y, then units. Cuarenta y cinco.

exercises.prompt: A friend suggests meeting a las nueve de la noche. When is that?
exercises.why: De la noche means at night. De la mañana means in the morning.

exercises.prompt: Tap the word that is wrong.
exercises.why: Three is plural: son las tres. Only la una takes es.

write.title: Say it in your own words
write.task: Make a plan with a friend: suggest a day and a time to meet, and say how much the tickets cost.
write.starter: Quedamos el…  a las…  Las entradas cuestan…
write.model: Quedamos el sábado a las ocho y media. Las entradas cuestan quince euros.
checklist: The day takes el, with no word for "on"
The time uses a las (or a la una)
Numbers above 30 use y: treinta y cinco

boss.title: Train tickets at Atocha
boss.persona: You are Carmen, a ticket clerk at Madrid Atocha station. The learner is buying a train ticket. Talk about destinations, days, departure times and prices, using numbers and times often. Address the learner as usted.

turns.npc: ¡Buenos días! ¿Para qué día quiere el billete a Toledo?
turns.en: Good morning! Which day do you want the ticket to Toledo for?
choices: Para el sábado, por favor.
Para los sábados, por favor.
Los sábados means every Saturday. For one trip: el sábado.
Para sábado, por favor.
Days need el: para el sábado.

turns.npc: Hay trenes a las diez y cuarto y a las doce y media. ¿Cuál prefiere?
turns.en: There are trains at quarter past ten and half past twelve. Which do you prefer?
choices: A las diez y cuarto, por favor.
En las diez y cuarto, por favor.
At a time is a: a las diez y cuarto.
A la diez y cuarto, por favor.
Ten is plural: a las diez.

turns.npc: Muy bien. Son doce euros con cincuenta.
turns.en: Very good. That's twelve euros fifty.
choices: ¿Doce con cincuenta? Vale, aquí tiene.
¿Veinte con cincuenta? Vale, aquí tiene.
Veinte is 20. Doce is 12.
¿Dos con cincuenta? Vale, aquí tiene.
Dos is 2. Doce is 12.

turns.npc: Gracias. El tren llega a Toledo a las once menos diez.
turns.en: Thank you. The train arrives in Toledo at ten to eleven.
choices: ¿A las diez cincuenta? Perfecto, gracias.
¿A las once y diez? Perfecto, gracias.
Menos diez means ten TO eleven, so 10:50, not 11:10.
¿A las nueve y diez? Perfecto, gracias.
Once is eleven. Once menos diez is 10:50.

boss.closingEn: You're welcome. Have a good trip!
boss.chatOpeningEn: Do you also need a return ticket?
